headline: Turkish Central Bank Easing Cycle Splits Analysts
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey recently cut rates by 100 basis points to 36% following an eight-month pause, leaving analysts split on whether further easing will continue.
why: Central bank policy rates dictate borrowing costs and currency valuations in emerging markets, influencing foreign investment flows and domestic inflation expectations.

entities.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey

impacts.name: Turkey policy rate
impacts.why: A rate cut directly lowers the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate.
